# VisFurn

VISFURN is the project-door brand operated by Tianjin Visfurn Import and Export Trading Co., Ltd., established in 2005. Based in China, the company supports commercial and institutional wooden door procurement with specification-led quotation review. Buyers can send a door schedule, drawings, quantities, opening information, wall thickness, finish direction, hardware preparation and destination.

## Product lines
- WPC doors — moisture-aware interior door systems for bathrooms, utility rooms and humid project areas.
- Composite entry doors — coordinated entry door systems for apartment and repeated-opening projects.
- Fire-rated steel doors — steel door systems for projects requiring authority-specific assembly evidence.
- Hermetic sliding doors — healthcare door systems for operating rooms, clinical zones and clean corridors.
- Hotel guestroom doors — guestroom, suite and service-opening door systems with frame and hardware coordination.
- School doors — classroom and public-area door systems for education projects.
- PVC interior doors — PVC-finished interior door systems for residential and hospitality openings.
